#!/bin/bash
# run-eyes.sh — Onion Eyes harness. Runs ON the GitHub Actions runner via
# the cloud-pc workflow (pc.py shell job, cwd = cloud-pc/storage):
#   bash eyes/run-eyes.sh setup        # idempotent SDK/AVD prep (own job)
#   bash eyes/run-eyes.sh run <id>     # boot -> install -> seed -> steps
#
# Boots a Note10-profile AVD (google_apis x86_64 — API 34 image, the
# house-proven native-app image; 1080x2280 @420dpi, fontScale 1.0,
# animations off, SystemUI demo mode), installs the spec's
# APK (md5-verified), seeds DEMO data only, then executes the spec's
# declarative step list (the HANDS step API — see SKILL.md). EVERY capture
# is committed+pushed the moment it exists, so the workflow's 50-min cap
# and the stale inbox pile can never lose results (house self-push
# pattern, same as the stream gates and the emu walker).
#
# Spec: cloud-pc/storage/eyes/jobs/<id>.json
#   { id, package, apkUrl, apkMd5, api, image, width, height, density,
#     permissions: ["READ_CONTACTS", ...],
#     seedContacts: [{given, family, phone, accountName, accountType,
#                     starred}],
#     steps: [ {do: ...}, ... ] }
# Results: cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/<id>/
#   <label>.png / .xml / .texts.txt, <label>.mp4, steps.tsv, harness.log,
#   logcat.txt, result.json
set -u
MODE=${1:-}
EYES_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
REPO=$(cd "$EYES_DIR/../.." && pwd)
# v2 (2026-11-15, diag-proven): the Actions cache holds ONLY ollama files —
# there is NO cached android-sdk, and the system SDK has no emulator and
# no system images. So: build a private SDK in $HOME, COPY everything the
# system SDK already has (fast local disk), and download ONLY the two
# missing pieces (emulator + one system image) — the leanest install that
# fits pc.py's 600 s/job cap.
SDK=$HOME/eyes-sdk
SYS_SDK=/usr/local/lib/android/sdk
export ANDROID_HOME=$SDK ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$SDK
export ANDROID_AVD_HOME=$HOME/emu-avd-home
mkdir -p "$SDK" "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME" "$EYES_DIR/results" "$EYES_DIR/jobs"

# ---------- git: commit+push paths, surviving main-branch races ----------
# v3 (2026-11-15): pushes on this repo can take MANY minutes to win a
# slot when several runs push concurrently (diag evidence: ~25 min).
# A synchronous push inside a 600 s job can therefore eat the whole job.
# So: bg_push() queues pushes into ONE background pusher (flock-
# serialized, long retry loop) that keeps working after this job's
# process exits — the runner lives until the workflow's 50-min cap.
# push_sync() is the bounded synchronous variant for final results.
git config --global user.name "onion-eyes" 2>/dev/null
git config --global user.email "eyes@local" 2>/dev/null
PUSH_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
commit_push() { # $1 = message, rest = repo-relative paths
  local msg=$1; shift
  local try tries=${PUSH_TRIES:-10} slp=${PUSH_SLEEP:-3}
  for try in $(seq 1 $tries); do
    ( cd "$REPO" && git add -A -- "$@" 2>/dev/null )
    ( cd "$REPO" && git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null ) || \
      ( cd "$REPO" && git commit -q -m "$msg" 2>/dev/null ) || true
    ( cd "$REPO" && git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null )
    if ! ( cd "$REPO" && git rebase -q origin/main 2>/dev/null ); then
      ( cd "$REPO" && git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null ); sleep $slp; continue
    fi
    if ( cd "$REPO" && git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null ); then return 0; fi
    sleep $slp
  done
  echo "WARN: push failed after retries: $msg"
  return 1
}
bg_push() { # fire-and-forget, long retries, serialized via flock
  ( flock -x 9; PUSH_TRIES=25 PUSH_SLEEP=10 commit_push "$@" ) \
    9>"$PUSH_TMP/push.lock" >>"$PUSH_TMP/push.log" 2>&1 &
}
push_sync() { # bounded synchronous push, serialized via the same flock;
              # if the lock stays busy >240 s, give up — the queued
              # bg_push of the same paths still delivers.
  ( flock -x -w 240 9 || exit 0; PUSH_TRIES=6 PUSH_SLEEP=3 commit_push "$@" ) \
    9>"$PUSH_TMP/push.lock"
}

# ---------- v4: GitHub Contents API push (the fast lane) ----------
# Git pushes on this repo are slow tonight: every attempt must fetch
# the giant, constantly-advancing history before it can rebase+push
# (diag evidence: ~25 min for one small file). The Contents API commits
# ONE file directly on the server in a single HTTPS call — no history
# transfer. The token is the checkout's own credential, extracted from
# the local git config extraheader (never printed). Falls back to the
# git path (bg_push) when extraction or the API fails.
API_TOKEN=""
_hdr=$(git config --get http.https://github.com/.extraheader 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$_hdr" ]; then
  API_TOKEN=$(printf '%s' "${_hdr##* }" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^[^:]*://')
fi
api_put() { # $1 = message, rest = repo-relative paths (files <= ~900 KB)
  local msg=$1; shift
  if [ -z "$API_TOKEN" ]; then bg_push "$msg" "$@"; return 0; fi
  API_TOKEN="$API_TOKEN" API_MSG="$msg" python3 - "$@" <<'PYEOF'
import base64, json, os, sys, time, urllib.request, urllib.error
token = os.environ["API_TOKEN"]; msg = os.environ["API_MSG"]
REPO = "boo4blue/boo4blue.github.io"
def req(method, url, body=None):
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method,
        data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
                 "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
                 "Content-Type": "application/json",
                 "User-Agent": "onion-eyes"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=60) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read() or b"{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, {}
    except Exception:
        return 0, {}
base = os.getcwd()  # storage cwd; repo root is ../..
for rel in sys.argv[1:]:
    local = os.path.join(base, "..", "..", rel) if not rel.startswith("cloud-pc/") \
            else os.path.join(base, "..", "..", rel)
    if not os.path.exists(local):
        print("api_put: missing", rel); continue
    data = open(local, "rb").read()
    if len(data) > 900_000:
        print("api_put: too big for contents API, needs git path:", rel); continue
    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/contents/{rel}"
    ok = False
    for attempt in range(6):
        _, cur = req("GET", url + "?ref=main")
        body = {"message": msg, "branch": "main",
                "content": base64.b64encode(data).decode()}
        if cur.get("sha"): body["sha"] = cur["sha"]
        st, _ = req("PUT", url, body)
        if st in (200, 201): ok = True; break
        time.sleep(3 + attempt * 2)
    print("api_put:", rel, "OK" if ok else "FAILED")
PYEOF
}

# ---------- real-scene camera: the curl-dance HLS pump ----------
# Blaze's order 2026-11-15 17:09/17:10 CST: camera tests must run against
# a REAL scene — a live public camera piped into the emulator (route A)
# or real recorded footage from a real, named place (route B, always
# labeled recorded). The emulator test pattern NEVER counts as camera
# proof, and synthetic/virtual scenes do not count at all.
# campump.py serves CDNs that refuse ffmpeg's HTTP stack (EarthCam):
# it does the browser dance with curl (page -> cookies + tokenized
# playlist -> chunklist -> .ts segments) and emits a plain MPEG-TS
# stream that ffmpeg CAN read (recorded file or live pipe to v4l2).
PUMPD=""
write_pump() {
  PUMPD=$(mktemp -d)
  cat > "$PUMPD/campump.py" <<'PYEOF'
import re, subprocess, sys, time
UA = ("Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
      "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126 Safari/537.36")
def make_curl(jar):
    def curl(url, referer=None, binary=False, timeout=25):
        cmd = ["curl", "-sL", "--max-time", str(timeout), "-A", UA,
               "-b", jar, "-c", jar]
        if referer: cmd += ["-H", "Referer: " + referer]
        cmd += [url]
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("curl rc=%d %s" % (r.returncode, url[:90]))
        return r.stdout if binary else r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    return curl
def resolve(curl, page, feed):
    html = curl(page)
    m = re.search(r"fecnetwork\\/" + re.escape(feed) +
                  r"\.flv\\/playlist\.m3u8\?t=[^\"' ]+", html)
    if not m: raise RuntimeError("no tokenized playlist for feed " + feed)
    pl = "https://videos3.earthcam.com/" + m.group(0).replace("\\/", "/")
    master = curl(pl, referer=page)
    if "#EXTM3U" not in master: raise RuntimeError("master not m3u8")
    base = pl.rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/"
    for line in master.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line and not line.startswith("#"):
            return (line if line.startswith("http") else base + line), base
    raise RuntimeError("no chunklist in master playlist")
def segments(curl, chunk_url, base, page):
    media = curl(chunk_url, referer=page)
    out, dur = [], None
    for line in media.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith("#EXTINF:"):
            dur = float(line.split(":")[1].split(",")[0])
        elif line and not line.startswith("#"):
            out.append((line if line.startswith("http") else base + line,
                        dur or 2.0))
            dur = None
    return out
def main():
    mode, page, feed = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    jar = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "/tmp/campump-cookies.txt"
    curl = make_curl(jar)
    chunk_url, base = resolve(curl, page, feed)
    print("pump: chunklist ok for feed %s" % feed, file=sys.stderr)
    seen = set()
    if mode == "record":
        seconds, outpath = float(sys.argv[5]), sys.argv[6]
        collected, deadline = 0.0, time.time() + seconds + 90
        with open(outpath, "wb") as out:
            while collected < seconds and time.time() < deadline:
                new = 0
                for url, d in segments(curl, chunk_url, base, page):
                    key = url.split("?")[0]
                    if key in seen: continue
                    seen.add(key)
                    data = curl(url, referer=page, binary=True, timeout=30)
                    if len(data) < 10000: continue
                    out.write(data); collected += d; new += 1
                    if collected >= seconds: break
                if new == 0: time.sleep(2)
        print("pump: recorded %.1fs -> %s" % (collected, outpath),
              file=sys.stderr)
        if collected < 3: sys.exit(2)
    elif mode == "live":
        out = sys.stdout.buffer
        deadline = time.time() + 2400
        while time.time() < deadline:
            new = 0
            try:
                for url, d in segments(curl, chunk_url, base, page):
                    key = url.split("?")[0]
                    if key in seen: continue
                    seen.add(key)
                    data = curl(url, referer=page, binary=True, timeout=30)
                    if len(data) < 10000: continue
                    out.write(data); out.flush(); new += 1
            except Exception as e:
                print("pump: segment error: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
                time.sleep(3)
            if new == 0: time.sleep(2)
    else:
        sys.exit("unknown mode " + mode)
main()
PYEOF
}

# ---------- SDK install (idempotent, lean: copy local, download 2 pieces) ----------
sdk_install() { # $1 = log file, $2 = image package (default house profile)
  local LOG=$1 IMG=${2:-system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64}
  mkdir -p "$SDK/cmdline-tools"
  [ -d "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest" ] || cp -r "$SYS_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest" "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest"
  [ -d "$SDK/platform-tools" ] || cp -r "$SYS_SDK/platform-tools" "$SDK/platform-tools"
  [ -d "$SDK/platforms" ] || cp -r "$SYS_SDK/platforms" "$SDK/platforms"
  [ -d "$SDK/licenses" ] || cp -r "$SYS_SDK/licenses" "$SDK/licenses" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | \
    sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules >/dev/null 2>&1
  sudo udevadm control --reload-rules 2>/dev/null; sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
  local SDKM="$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$SDK"
  yes | $SDKM --licenses >> "$LOG" 2>&1
  local attempt imgdir
  imgdir=$(echo "$IMG" | sed 's/;/\//g')
  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    $SDKM "emulator" "$IMG" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
    echo "sdkmanager attempt $attempt exit=$?"
    if [ -x "$SDK/emulator/emulator" ] && [ -f "$SDK/$imgdir/system.img" ]; then
      echo "SDK verified OK on attempt $attempt"; return 0
    fi
    rm -rf "$SDK/emulator" "$SDK/.temp"; sleep 5
  done
  echo "SDK install FAILED after 3 attempts"; return 1
}

if [ "$MODE" = "setup" ]; then
  VLOG="$EYES_DIR/setup-verdict.txt"
  exec > >(tee -a "$VLOG") 2>&1
  echo "== eyes setup $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$EYES_DIR/setup-heartbeat.txt"
  api_put "eyes: setup heartbeat" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/setup-heartbeat.txt"
  if sdk_install "$EYES_DIR/setup.log"; then echo "SETUP_OK"; else echo "SETUP_FAIL"; fi
  api_put "eyes: setup verdict" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/setup-verdict.txt" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/setup.log"
  bg_push "eyes: setup verdict" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/setup-verdict.txt" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/setup.log"
  exit 0
fi

# ---------- camprep: real-scene camera preparation (own job) ----------
# Verifies candidate REAL cameras from the spec's cameraScene.sources
# (first verified-live wins), attempts a v4l2loopback virtual webcam
# for route A (live), and records the route B clip from the SAME live
# source. State lands in $HOME/eyes-cam/<id>/ (shared with the run job
# on this runner) + camprep.json in the results dir, rewritten after
# every stage so a job-cap kill never loses the state reached.
if [ "$MODE" = "camprep" ]; then
  ID=${2:-}
  [ -n "$ID" ] || { echo "need camprep <id>"; exit 1; }
  SPEC="$EYES_DIR/jobs/$ID.json"
  [ -f "$SPEC" ] || { echo "FATAL: spec $SPEC not found"; exit 1; }
  RESULTS="$EYES_DIR/results/$ID"
  mkdir -p "$RESULTS"
  exec > >(tee -a "$RESULTS/camprep.log") 2>&1
  echo "== eyes camprep $ID $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$RESULTS/heartbeat.txt"
  api_put "eyes $ID: camprep heartbeat" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/heartbeat.txt"
  CAMD=$HOME/eyes-cam/$ID
  mkdir -p "$CAMD"
  : > "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
  write_pump
  CLIPSEC=$(python3 -c "import json; j=json.load(open('$SPEC')); print(max(15, min(120, int((j.get('cameraScene') or {}).get('clipSeconds', 45)))))" 2>/dev/null || echo 45)
  echo "clipSeconds=$CLIPSEC"
  # --- stage 0: toolchain. ffprobe/ffmpeg are load-bearing (probes,
  # route-A feed, clip transcode). NEVER assume the image ships them:
  # the first realscene run (2026-11-15) had the pump record real
  # EarthCam segments while EVERY ffprobe probe failed — the probes
  # were the broken step, not the sources. Install if missing, and log
  # the toolchain state so a silent absence can never fake a
  # "no live sources" result again. ---
  if ! command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ffmpeg/ffprobe missing — installing (bounded), log: camprep-apt.log"
    timeout 90 sudo apt-get update -qq >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
    timeout 220 sudo apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
  fi
  echo "attempt: toolchain ffmpeg=$(command -v ffmpeg || echo MISSING) ffprobe=$(command -v ffprobe || echo MISSING)" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
  ffmpeg -version 2>/dev/null | head -1 >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
  CV4L2=0; SRC_TYPE=""; SRC_NAME=""; SRC_PLACE=""; SRC_URL=""; SRC_PAGE=""; SRC_FEED=""
  CLIP_PATH=""; CLIP_BYTES=""; CLIP_DUR=""
  cam_write_json() {
    ID="$ID" CV4L2="$CV4L2" SRC_TYPE="$SRC_TYPE" SRC_NAME="$SRC_NAME" \
    SRC_PLACE="$SRC_PLACE" SRC_URL="$SRC_URL" SRC_PAGE="$SRC_PAGE" SRC_FEED="$SRC_FEED" \
    CLIP_PATH="$CLIP_PATH" CLIP_BYTES="$CLIP_BYTES" CLIP_DUR="$CLIP_DUR" \
    CAMD="$CAMD" python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, datetime
r = os.environ
att = []
p = os.path.join(r["CAMD"], "attempts.txt")
if os.path.exists(p):
    att = [l.rstrip("\n") for l in open(p) if l.strip()]
src = None
if r["SRC_NAME"]:
    src = {"type": r["SRC_TYPE"], "name": r["SRC_NAME"], "place": r["SRC_PLACE"],
           "url": r["SRC_URL"] or None, "page": r["SRC_PAGE"] or None,
           "feed": r["SRC_FEED"] or None}
clip = None
if r["CLIP_PATH"]:
    clip = {"path": r["CLIP_PATH"],
            "bytes": int(r["CLIP_BYTES"] or 0),
            "seconds": r["CLIP_DUR"] or None}
json.dump({"id": r["ID"], "v4l2": r["CV4L2"] == "1", "source": src,
           "clip": clip, "attempts": att,
           "updatedUtc": datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")},
          open(os.path.join(r["CAMD"], "camprep.json"), "w"), indent=2)
print("camprep.json updated (v4l2=%s source=%s clip=%s)" %
      (r["CV4L2"], r["SRC_NAME"] or "-", "yes" if clip else "no"))
PY
    cp "$CAMD/camprep.json" "$RESULTS/camprep.json" 2>/dev/null
    api_put "eyes $ID: camprep state" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/camprep.json" || true
  }
  probe_hls() { # $1 = url -> 0 if a real video stream answers
    local out
    out=$(timeout 25 ffprobe -v error -rw_timeout 15000000 \
      -show_entries stream=codec_type -of csv "$1" 2>&1)
    if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q video; then return 0; fi
    echo "probe detail ($1): $(printf '%s' "$out" | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-220)" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
    return 1
  }
  # --- stage 1: virtual webcam (route A hardware) ---
  if [ -e /dev/video0 ]; then
    CV4L2=1; echo "attempt: /dev/video0 already present" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
  else
    echo "installing v4l2loopback (bounded) — log: camprep-apt.log"
    timeout 90 sudo apt-get update -qq >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
    timeout 160 sudo apt-get install -y -qq v4l2loopback-dkms >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
    sudo modprobe v4l2loopback devices=1 video_nr=0 card_label=OnionSceneCam exclusive_caps=1 >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
    if [ -e /dev/video0 ]; then CV4L2=1
    else
      echo "v4l2loopback failed; trying akvcam (bounded)"
      timeout 130 sudo apt-get install -y -qq akvcam-dkms >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
      sudo modprobe akvcam >> "$RESULTS/camprep-apt.log" 2>&1
      [ -e /dev/video0 ] && CV4L2=1
    fi
    echo "attempt: virtual webcam module -> /dev/video0 present=$([ $CV4L2 = 1 ] && echo yes || echo no)" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
  fi
  # the device node is root-owned by default and the runner user
  # cannot WRITE it — camera-realscene3's route A died on exactly
  # this ("Could not write header ... Permission denied" opening
  # /dev/video0). Open it up while we have sudo.
  if [ $CV4L2 = 1 ]; then
    sudo chmod 666 /dev/video0 2>/dev/null
    echo "attempt: /dev/video0 perms -> $(stat -c '%a %U:%G' /dev/video0 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
  fi
  cam_write_json
  # --- stage 2: source resolution (first verified-live wins) ---
  python3 - "$SPEC" > "$CAMD/candidates.tsv" <<'PY'
import json, sys
j = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
for s in (j.get("cameraScene") or {}).get("sources", []):
    t = s.get("type", "")
    if t == "earthcam":
        a, b = s.get("page", ""), s.get("feed", "")
    else:
        a, b = s.get("url", ""), ""
    print("\t".join([t, s.get("name", ""), s.get("place", ""), a, b]))
PY
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r ctype cname cplace cref cref2; do
    [ -n "$ctype" ] || continue
    [ -z "$SRC_NAME" ] || break
    echo "trying source: $ctype — $cname ($cplace)"
    case "$ctype" in
      hls)
        if probe_hls "$cref"; then
          SRC_TYPE=hls; SRC_NAME=$cname; SRC_PLACE=$cplace; SRC_URL=$cref
          echo "attempt: hls $cname ($cref) -> LIVE" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
        else
          echo "attempt: hls $cname ($cref) -> no video stream" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
        fi ;;
      earthcam)
        ecok=0
        if timeout 120 python3 "$PUMPD/campump.py" record "$cref" "$cref2" "$CAMD/cookies.txt" 6 "$CAMD/probe.ts" 2>>"$CAMD/attempts.txt"; then
          # network-independent proof the pump pulled real MPEG-TS video:
          # sync bytes at 188-byte strides over a substantial sample,
          # with ffprobe as a second opinion when it exists.
          if python3 - "$CAMD/probe.ts" <<'PY'
import sys
try:
    d = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read(188 * 40)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)
ok = len(d) >= 188 * 20 and d[0] == 0x47 and d[188] == 0x47 and d[376] == 0x47
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
          then ecok=1
          elif timeout 20 ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_type -of csv "$CAMD/probe.ts" 2>/dev/null | grep -q video; then ecok=1
          fi
          echo "attempt: earthcam $cname (feed $cref2) probe.ts=$(stat -c%s "$CAMD/probe.ts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)B ts-structure/ffprobe ok=$ecok" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
        fi
        if [ $ecok = 1 ]; then
          SRC_TYPE=earthcam; SRC_NAME=$cname; SRC_PLACE=$cplace; SRC_PAGE=$cref; SRC_FEED=$cref2
          echo "attempt: earthcam $cname (feed $cref2) -> LIVE" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
          ffmpeg -v error -i "$CAMD/probe.ts" -frames:v 1 -y "$RESULTS/source-frame.jpg" 2>/dev/null
          [ -f "$RESULTS/source-frame.jpg" ] && api_put "eyes $ID: source frame ($cname)" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/source-frame.jpg" || true
        else
          echo "attempt: earthcam $cname (feed $cref2) -> pump failed" >> "$CAMD/attempts.txt"
        fi ;;
      wi511)
        curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126 Safari/537.36" "$cref" -o "$CAMD/wi511.json" 2>/dev/null
        python3 - "$CAMD/wi511.json" > "$CAMD/wi511-urls.txt" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
try:
    txt = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
urls = []
for m in re.finditer(r'https?://[^"\\\s]+\.m3u8[^"\\\s]*', txt):
    u = m.group(0)
    if u not in urls:
        urls.append(u)
for u in urls[:6]:
    print(u)
PY
        wn=0
        while IFS= read -r wurl; do
          [ -n "$wurl" ] || continue
          wn=$((wn+1)); [ $wn -le 4 ] || break
          if probe_hls "$wurl"; then

seed_one() { # given family phone account_name account_type starred email

  # with spaces and the device shell re-tokenizes, so an unquoted value
  # with a space ("Avery Collins") splits and the insert fails. Every adb
  # call takes stdin from /dev/null so it cannot drain the seed loop's
  # input file (that bug ate seeds 2-5 in the 0-contacts-v151 run).
  local prev rid out
  prev=$(adb shell content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --projection _id < /dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep -o '_id=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2 | sort -n | tail -1)

      --bind "account_type:s:'$5'" --bind "account_name:s:'$4'" --bind starred:i:$6 < /dev/null 2>&1)
  else
    out=$(adb shell content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts \
      --bind starred:i:$6 < /dev/null 2>&1)
  fi
  rid=$(adb shell content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --projection _id < /dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep -o '_id=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2 | sort -n | tail -1)
  if [ -z "$rid" ] || [ "$rid" = "$prev" ]; then echo "SEED FAIL $1 $2 (raw: $out)"; return; fi
  adb shell content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/data \
    --bind raw_contact_id:i:$rid --bind mimetype:s:vnd.android.cursor.item/name \
    --bind "data1:s:'$1 $2'" --bind "data2:s:'$1'" --bind "data3:s:'$2'" < /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1

  fi
  echo "seeded $1 $2 rid=$rid"
}

r = os.environ
json.dump({"route": r["CAMROUTE"], "sourceName": r["CSRC_NAME"] or None,
           "sourcePlace": r["CSRC_PLACE"] or None,
           "sourceType": r["CSRC_TYPE"] or None,
           "startedUtc": datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")},
          open(sys.argv[1], "w"), indent=2)
print("route.json written")
PY
    api_put "eyes $ID: camera route ($CAMROUTE)" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/route.json"
  fi
fi

# ---------- AVD + boot ----------
IMG_PKG="system-images;android-$API;$IMAGE;x86_64"
if [ -z "$NOTE" ]; then
  pkill -f qemu-system 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; adb kill-server 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
  echo no | $AVDM create avd -n eyesavd -k "$IMG_PKG" -d pixel_6 --force > "$RESULTS/avd.log" 2>&1
  CFG="$ANDROID_AVD_HOME/eyesavd.avd/config.ini"
  for kv in "hw.lcd.width=$WIDTH" "hw.lcd.height=$HEIGHT" "hw.lcd.density=$DENSITY"; do
    k=${kv%%=*}
    if grep -q "^$k=" "$CFG" 2>/dev/null; then sed -i "s|^$k=.*|$kv|" "$CFG"; else echo "$kv" >> "$CFG"; fi
  done
  nohup $SDK/emulator/emulator -avd eyesavd -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim \
    -gpu swiftshader_indirect -feature -Vulkan -memory 2048 -accel on -no-snapshot \
    $CAMARGS \
    > "$RESULTS/boot.log" 2>&1 &
  timeout 150 adb wait-for-device
  for i in $(seq 1 48); do
    b=$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
    if [ "$b" = "1" ]; then BOOTOK=1; echo "booted after ~$((i*5))s"; break; fi
    # fail fast if the emulator process died (a bad -camera-back value
    # exits instantly; camera-realscene2 burned the full boot wait
    # learning one line of emulator stderr). The live process is
    # qemu-system (the `emulator` binary execs it), so match that —
    # matching the launcher's cmdline false-fired on
    # camera-realscene3, whose emulator was starting normally.
    # Grace: only from iteration 3 (~10 s in), so a slow spawn is
    # never mistaken for a death.
    if [ $i -ge 3 ] && ! pgrep -f "[q]emu-system" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pgrep -f "[e]mulator -avd eyesavd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "emulator process exited during boot — see boot.log tail below"; break
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  [ "$BOOTOK" = 1 ] || { NOTE="emulator did not finish booting"; tail -8 "$RESULTS/boot.log"; }
fi

if [ -z "$NOTE" ]; then

  # seed demo contacts (if the spec declares any)

  while IFS=$'\t' read -r g f p an at st em; do

PY
  api_put "eyes $ID: progress (steps phase)" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/progress.json"

# ---------- step engine ----------
# run_steps <specfile> <index-prefix> — executes one spec file's steps
# through the shared dispatch below. jank_wrap recurses into run_steps
# with its nested steps written to a sub-spec, so a wrapped action runs
# through the exact same step code as a top-level step. (The field parser
# is factored into $TMPD/stepfields.py — same output as the old inline
# parser, plus ACTION and HAS_STEPS.)
run_steps() {
  local specf=$1 prefix=$2 nsteps idx st detail mydo
  nsteps=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get('steps',[])))" "$specf")
  idx=0
  while [ $idx -lt $nsteps ]; do
    eval "$(python3 "$TMPD/stepfields.py" "$specf" $idx)"
    mydo=$DO
    st=OK; detail=""
    case "$DO" in
      wait) ssec=${SECONDS:-0}; [ "$ssec" = 0 ] && ssec=2; sleep "$ssec"; detail="slept ${ssec}s" ;;
      launch)
        adb shell monkey -p $PACKAGE -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1
        ssec=${SECONDS:-0}; [ "$ssec" = 0 ] && ssec=6; sleep "$ssec"; detail="monkey launch" ;;
      tap_xy)
        tapfrac "$X" "$Y"; sleep 1; detail="tap frac $X,$Y" ;;
      tap_element|tap_text)
        uidump "$TMPD/ui.xml"
        found=$(python3 "$TMPD/findel.py" "$TMPD/ui.xml" "$TEXT" "${MATCH:-contains}" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$found" ]; then
          xy=$(echo "$found" | awk '{print $1, $2}')
          adb shell input tap $xy; sleep 1
          detail="tapped '$TEXT' at $xy"
        elif [ -n "$FALLBACK_XY" ]; then
          set -- $FALLBACK_XY; tapfrac "$1" "$2"; sleep 1
          st=FALLBACK; detail="'$TEXT' not in hierarchy; fallback tap $FALLBACK_XY"
        elif [ "$OPTIONAL" = 1 ]; then
          st=SKIP; detail="'$TEXT' not found (optional)"
        else
          st=FAIL; detail="'$TEXT' not found in UI hierarchy"
        fi ;;
      swipe|drag)
        set -- $FROM; fx=$1; fy=$2; set -- $TO; tx=$1; ty=$2
        dur=${DURATION_MS:-300}; [ "$DO" = drag ] && [ "${DURATION_MS:-0}" = 0 ] && dur=900
        adb shell input swipe $(awk -v w=$W -v h=$H -v a=$fx -v b=$fy 'BEGIN{printf "%d %d", w*a, h*b}') \
                              $(awk -v w=$W -v h=$H -v a=$tx -v b=$ty 'BEGIN{printf "%d %d", w*a, h*b}') $dur
        sleep 1; detail="$DO $FROM -> $TO ${dur}ms" ;;
      pinch)
        set -- $CENTER; cfx=$1; cfy=$2
        r1=${FROM_RADIUS:-0.10}; r2=${TO_RADIUS:-0.30}
        M=$W; [ $H -lt $W ] && M=$H
        cxp=$(awk -v w=$W -v f=$cfx 'BEGIN{printf "%d", w*f}')
        cyp=$(awk -v h=$H -v f=$cfy 'BEGIN{printf "%d", h*f}')
        d1=$(awk -v m=$M -v r=$r1 'BEGIN{printf "%d", m*r}')
        d2=$(awk -v m=$M -v r=$r2 'BEGIN{printf "%d", m*r}')
        adb shell input swipe $((cxp-d1)) $cyp $((cxp-d2)) $cyp 400 &
        adb shell input swipe $((cxp+d1)) $cyp $((cxp+d2)) $cyp 400 &
        wait
        sleep 1; detail="pinch center=$CENTER radius $r1->$r2 (dual-swipe, best-effort)" ;;
      type)
        esc=$(printf '%s' "$TEXT" | sed 's/%/%%/g; s/ /%s/g')
        adb shell input text "$esc"; sleep 1; detail="typed '$TEXT'" ;;
      key) adb shell input keyevent "$KEY"; sleep 1; detail="keyevent $KEY" ;;
      back) adb shell input keyevent BACK; sleep 1; detail="keyevent BACK" ;;
      scroll)
        case "$DIRECTION" in
          up)    adb shell input swipe $((W/2)) $((H/4)) $((W/2)) $((H*3/4)) 300 ;;
          left)  adb shell input swipe $((W/4)) $((H/2)) $((W*3/4)) $((H/2)) 300 ;;
          right) adb shell input swipe $((W*3/4)) $((H/2)) $((W/4)) $((H/2)) 300 ;;
          *)     adb shell input swipe $((W/2)) $((H*3/4)) $((W/2)) $((H/4)) 300 ;;
        esac
        sleep 1; detail="scroll $DIRECTION" ;;
      wait_text)
        tmo=${TIMEOUT:-20}; waited=0; st=FAIL
        while [ $waited -lt $tmo ]; do
          uidump "$TMPD/ui.xml"
          if python3 "$TMPD/findel.py" "$TMPD/ui.xml" "$TEXT" contains >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            st=OK; detail="'$TEXT' appeared after ~${waited}s"; break
          fi
          sleep 2; waited=$((waited+2))
        done
        [ "$st" = FAIL ] && detail="'$TEXT' not seen within ${tmo}s" ;;
      assert_text)
        uidump "$TMPD/ui.xml"
        if python3 "$TMPD/findel.py" "$TMPD/ui.xml" "$TEXT" contains >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          detail="assert ok: '$TEXT' present"
        elif [ "$SOFT" = 1 ]; then
          st=SOFTFAIL; detail="assert soft-fail: '$TEXT' not in hierarchy (vision check decides)"
        else
          st=FAIL; detail="assert failed: '$TEXT' not in hierarchy"
        fi ;;
      screenshot) shot_push "$LABEL"; detail="screenshot $LABEL" ;;
      observe)
        shot_push "$LABEL"
        uidump "$RESULTS/$LABEL.xml"
        python3 "$TMPD/texts.py" "$RESULTS/$LABEL.xml" > "$RESULTS/$LABEL.texts.txt" 2>/dev/null
        api_put "eyes $ID: observe $LABEL" \
          "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/$LABEL.xml" \
          "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/$LABEL.texts.txt" || true
        detail="observe $LABEL (png+xml+texts)" ;;
      record_start)
        adb shell rm -f /sdcard/eyes-rec.mp4 >/dev/null 2>&1
        adb shell screenrecord --size $((W/2))x$((H/2)) --bit-rate 1200000 /sdcard/eyes-rec.mp4 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        REC_ACTIVE=1; sleep 1; detail="screenrecord started ($((W/2))x$((H/2)) @1.2Mbps)" ;;
      record_stop) record_stop "${LABEL:-flow}"; detail="screenrecord stopped -> ${LABEL:-flow}.mp4" ;;
      shell) eval "$CMD" >/dev/null 2>&1; detail="shell: $CMD" ;;
      chaos_kill)
        # simulate Android killing the process mid-flow, then relaunch.
        # State restoration is asserted by the normal steps that follow.
        adb shell am kill $PACKAGE; sleep 2
        adb shell monkey -p $PACKAGE -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1
        ssec=${SECONDS:-0}; [ "$ssec" = 0 ] && ssec=6; sleep "$ssec"
        if [ -n "$(adb shell pidof $PACKAGE 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
          detail="am kill $PACKAGE + relaunch; pid alive — state restoration is asserted by the following steps"
        else
          st=FAIL; detail="app did not come back after am kill + relaunch"
        fi ;;
      rotate)
        # user_rotation only sticks because setup pinned
        # accelerometer_rotation=0. Hold in landscape for `seconds`
        # (default 2), then return to portrait — usable mid-flow, e.g.
        # with a modal open or a capture in progress.
        hold=${SECONDS:-0}; [ "$hold" = 0 ] && hold=2
        adb shell settings put system user_rotation 1; sleep "$hold"
        adb shell settings put system user_rotation 0; sleep 2
        detail="rotated: user_rotation 1 for ${hold}s, back to 0 (mid-flow)" ;;
      double_tap)
        px=""; py=""
        if [ -n "$TEXT" ]; then
          uidump "$TMPD/ui.xml"
          found=$(python3 "$TMPD/findel.py" "$TMPD/ui.xml" "$TEXT" "${MATCH:-contains}" 2>/dev/null)
          if [ -n "$found" ]; then
            px=$(echo "$found" | awk '{print $1}'); py=$(echo "$found" | awk '{print $2}')
          elif [ "$OPTIONAL" = 1 ]; then
            st=SKIP; detail="double_tap: '$TEXT' not found (optional)"
          else
            st=FAIL; detail="double_tap: '$TEXT' not found in UI hierarchy"
          fi
        elif [ -n "$X" ] && [ -n "$Y" ]; then
          px=$(awk -v w=$W -v x=$X 'BEGIN{printf "%d", w*x}')
          py=$(awk -v h=$H -v y=$Y 'BEGIN{printf "%d", h*y}')
        else
          st=FAIL; detail="double_tap: needs text or x/y"
        fi
        if [ "$st" = OK ] && [ -n "$px" ]; then
          # both taps inside ONE device-side shell so the gap is ~50ms,
          # not an adb round-trip apart
          adb shell "input tap $px $py; sleep 0.05; input tap $px $py"
          sleep 1; detail="double tap ~50ms apart at $px,$py"
        fi ;;
      ime_check)
        # focus the input named by `text` (or x/y), prove the soft
        # keyboard is up via dumpsys input_method, then assert the
        # primary-action element named by `action` sits inside the
        # visible unobstructed viewport rect (hierarchy root bounds of
        # the keyboard-open dump, tightened by the IME window frame
        # when dumpsys exposes it).
        uidump "$TMPD/ui.xml"
        if [ -n "$TEXT" ]; then
          found=$(python3 "$TMPD/findel.py" "$TMPD/ui.xml" "$TEXT" "${MATCH:-contains}" 2>/dev/null)
          if [ -n "$found" ]; then
            xy=$(echo "$found" | awk '{print $1, $2}')
            adb shell input tap $xy
          else
            st=FAIL; detail="ime_check: input '$TEXT' not found in hierarchy"
          fi
        elif [ -n "$X" ] && [ -n "$Y" ]; then
          tapfrac "$X" "$Y"
        else
          st=FAIL; detail="ime_check: needs text (input) or x/y, plus action (button to bounds-check)"
        fi
        if [ "$st" = OK ]; then
          sleep 2
          kb=$(adb shell dumpsys input_method 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec "mInputShown=true|mShowRequested=true" || true)
          if [ "${kb:-0}" -lt 1 ]; then
            st=FAIL; detail="ime_check: soft keyboard did not open after focusing the input"
          else
            uidump "$TMPD/ui-ime.xml"
            bout=$(python3 "$TMPD/boundsel.py" "$TMPD/ui-ime.xml" "$ACTION" "${MATCH:-contains}" 2>/dev/null)
            rootb=$(printf '%s\n' "$bout" | awk '$1=="ROOT"{print $2, $3, $4, $5}')
            actb=$(printf '%s\n' "$bout" | awk '$1!="ROOT"{print $1, $2, $3, $4}')
            if [ -z "$actb" ]; then
              st=FAIL; detail="ime_check: action element '$ACTION' not found with keyboard open"
            elif [ -z "$rootb" ]; then
              st=SOFTFAIL; detail="ime_check: keyboard up and '$ACTION' present, but no root bounds to grade the visible rect against"
            else
              set -- $rootb; rx1=$1; ry1=$2; rx2=$3; ry2=$4
              set -- $actb; ax1=$1; ay1=$2; ax2=$3; ay2=$4
              imetop=$(adb shell dumpsys window windows 2>/dev/null | grep -A30 'InputMethod' | grep -m1 -o 'mFrame=\[[0-9]*,[0-9]*\]\[[0-9]*,[0-9]*\]' | sed 's/mFrame=\[[0-9]*,\([0-9]*\)\].*/\1/')
              vbot=$ry2
              if [ -n "$imetop" ] && [ "$imetop" -gt 0 ] && [ "$imetop" -lt "$vbot" ]; then vbot=$imetop; fi
              if [ $ax1 -ge $rx1 ] && [ $ay1 -ge $ry1 ] && [ $ax2 -le $rx2 ] && [ $ay2 -le $vbot ]; then
                detail="ime_check: keyboard up; '$ACTION' bounds [$ax1,$ay1][$ax2,$ay2] inside visible rect [$rx1,$ry1][$rx2,$vbot]"
              else
                st=FAIL; detail="ime_check: '$ACTION' bounds [$ax1,$ay1][$ax2,$ay2] NOT inside visible rect [$rx1,$ry1][$rx2,$vbot] with keyboard open"
              fi
            fi
          fi
        fi ;;
      jank_wrap)
        # gfxinfo reset -> run the nested steps -> read gfxinfo back.
        # FAIL when janky frames > 5% or the 95th-percentile frame time
        # exceeds the 16ms (60fps) budget; SOFTFAIL when gfxinfo gives
        # nothing measurable (SwiftShader renders plenty of UI without
        # HWUI frame stats — unproven is not a pass).
        if [ "$HAS_STEPS" != 1 ]; then
          st=FAIL; detail="jank_wrap: no nested steps to wrap"
        else
          sub="$TMPD/janksub-${prefix}${idx}.json"
          python3 - "$specf" $idx "$sub" <<'PYSUB'
import json, sys
s = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["steps"][int(sys.argv[2])]
json.dump({"steps": s.get("steps", [])}, open(sys.argv[3], "w"))
PYSUB
          adb shell dumpsys gfxinfo $PACKAGE reset >/dev/null 2>&1
          run_steps "$sub" "${prefix}${idx}."
          eval "$(adb shell dumpsys gfxinfo $PACKAGE 2>/dev/null | python3 "$TMPD/gfxparse.py")"
          if [ -z "${FRAMES:-}" ] || [ "${FRAMES:-0}" = 0 ]; then
            st=SOFTFAIL; detail="jank_wrap: gfxinfo recorded no frames for the wrapped action — jank unproven"
          elif [ -z "${JANKY_PCT:-}" ] || [ -z "${P95_MS:-}" ]; then
            st=SOFTFAIL; detail="jank_wrap: gfxinfo output unparseable (frames=$FRAMES) — jank unproven"
          else
            bad=""
            awk -v p="$JANKY_PCT" 'BEGIN{exit !(p>5)}' && bad="janky ${JANKY_PCT}% > 5%"
            if [ "$P95_MS" -gt 16 ]; then bad="${bad:+$bad; }p95 ${P95_MS}ms > 16ms"; fi
            if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
              st=FAIL; detail="jank_wrap: $bad (frames=$FRAMES janky=${JANKY_PCT}% p95=${P95_MS}ms)"
            else
              detail="jank_wrap: frames=$FRAMES janky=${JANKY_PCT}% p95=${P95_MS}ms — within budget"
            fi
          fi
        fi ;;
      *) st=FAIL; detail="unknown step do=$DO" ;;
    esac
    step_log "${prefix}$idx" "$mydo" "$st" "$detail"
    idx=$((idx+1))
  done
}
if [ -z "$NOTE" ]; then
  run_steps "$SPEC" ""
fi
